query: WITH entities AS (SELECT id FROM subscribers WHERE id = $1) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $2 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, p.payload as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN subscriber_events e ON i.id = e.id LEFT JOIN subscribers_forgettable_payloads p ON e.id = p.entity_id AND e.sequence = p.sequence ORDER BY i.id, e.sequence
